long_biography.plain_text:
John Hasan Ruiz turned decades of trial practice into a data-driven healthcare-recovery business. His work on insurance, class-action and medical claims exposed payments made by the wrong insurer. He designed information systems and algorithms to identify those claims, then founded MSP Recovery in 2014 to pursue reimbursement on behalf of healthcare organisations.

Cigarette Racing Team made a lifelong interest in speed part of Ruiz's business life. After watching Miami performance boats from Collins Avenue as a child, he acquired the manufacturer with Lionheart Capital and became a hands-on owner. The business has since moved to next-generation family leadership under his son Alex.

The immutable Maverick relationship first matches Boat International's named owner profile; that profile connects the owner to Cigarette Racing, and Boat International's earlier direct interview connects the same Cigarette owner to native Miami, trial law and healthcare data analytics. SEC, Florida Bar and Forbes records then converge on John Hasan Ruiz. The boxer, psychologist, golfer and other professionals found in focused searches do not match that complete chain.

No sufficiently strong source supplied a precise date or unambiguous birthplace wording, so birth day, month, year and place remain unproposed.

Forbes's dedicated profile was last substantively updated in 2023 and its monetary estimate is tied to a volatile public-company stake. Current SEC records still establish Ruiz's substantial beneficial ownership and control, which supports the durable healthcare origin and founder relationship, but no current net-worth figure is proposed or used in either biography.

Strong contemporary sources establish Ruiz's 2021 acquisition with Lionheart Capital and his hands-on ownership role. The official company site now identifies his son Alex as chief executive, but the precise current ownership split is not public; the longer biography therefore states the acquisition and leadership transition without claiming a current percentage or sole ownership.
